questions.question: How many types of igneous rocks are there?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Two.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Igneous rock** can form either beneath the **surface as intrusive rocks or on the surface as extrusive (volcanic) rocks, with or without crystallisation. **
 
• This magma can come from partial melts of existing rocks in the mantle or crust of a planet. 
 
• One or more of three procedures can manufacture melting: **an increase in temperature, a drop in pressure, or a change in composition**.
 
• Their are two types of igneous rocks:** extrusive and intrusive rocks ****​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Types of rocks are intrusive igneous rocks and extrusive igneous rocks 
 
 
• **Intrusive igneous rocks** are** crystallize beneath the earth’s surface resulting in large crystals as the cooling takes place steadily. **
 
• **Diorite, granite, pegmatite** are intrusive igneous rocks.
 
• **Extrusive igneous rocks break out onto the surface developing in tiny crystals as the cooling takes place very fast. **
 
• **Basalt, tuff, pumice** are extrusive igneous rocks.
 
 
 
• **​Examples **of extrusive igneous rocks are
 
 
• Mica
 
• Quartz
 
• Basalt

questions.question: Which of the following formulas is correct for Gross Value Added?

options.text: Gross Value Added = Gross National Product – Subsidies + Taxes
Gross Value Added = Gross Domestic Product – Subsidies + Taxes
Gross Value Added = Gross National Product + Subsidies – Taxes
Gross Value Added = Gross Domestic Product + Subsidies – Taxes

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Gross Value Added = Gross Domestic Product + Subsidies – Taxes.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Gross value added (GVA) is determined as **output (at basic prices) minus intermediate consumption (at purchaser prices**)
 
• It is the stabilizing item of the national accounts production account. GVA can be split down by **industry and institutional sector.**
 
• Gross value added (GVA) is **an economic productivity metric that computes the particip[ation of a corporate subsidiary, company, or municipality to an economy, producer, sector, or region**. 

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gross value added** measures **profits and wages of London-based businesses and London's employees.**
 
• **GVA= GDP + subsidies on products – taxes on products**.
 
 
• As the total aggregates of taxes on products and subsidies on products are only available at whole economy level, Gross value added is worked for computing **gross regional domestic product and other measures of the output** of entities smaller than an entire economy.
 
 
 
• It can also be worked to compute** how much money a product or service has contributed toward meeting a company's fixed costs.**

questions.question: Which Constitutional Amendment Act included Fundamental Duties in the Indian Constitution?
questions.solution:

• The **42nd Amendment** also attached a new segment to the Article on **"Fundamental Duties" **in the Constitution. 
 
• The new segment prescribed citizens **"to promote coordination and the spirit of common brotherhood in the middle of all the people of India, transcending religious, linguistic and regional or sectional diversities."**
 
• 42nd Constitution (Amendment) Act, 1976, a **new Chapter IV-A** which be composed of only one Article i.e **51-A** was attached which dealt with a** Code of Ten Fundamental Duties for citizens.**

questions.question: The SI unit of work is ______.
questions.solution:

__
 
• **The SI unit of work is the joule (J).** 
 
• It is explained as the work done by a force of** one newton through a distance of one metre.**
 
• One joule is determined as the amount of energy exerted when a force of one newton is applied over a displacement of one meter. 
 
• **One joule is the equal to one watt** of power radiated or dissipated for one second.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Decibel (dB)**, is a **unit for expressing the ratio in the middle of two physical quantities, generally amounts of acoustic or electric power, or for measuring the relative loudness of sounds.**
 
• **​A pascal** is a pressure of one newton per square meter.
 
• The hertz (symbol: Hz) is **the unit of frequency in the International System of Units (SI) equal to one event (or cycle) per second**.

questions.question: The distribution of the population according to different types of occupation is known as __________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Occupational Structure __**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Occupational structure mentions** to the aggregate distribution of occupations in society, determined by skill level, economic function, or social rank**.
 
• Many factors effect the occupational structure, counting the** economy's structure, technology and bureaucracy, the labor market, and status and prestige.**
 
• The occupational structure is the allocation of occupations in the community, arranged according to economic function, skill level, or social status.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Age Composition** in population studies, the proportionate numbers of persons in successive age groups in a given population. 
 
• Age distributions differ between countries mainly due to differences in the **levels and trends of fertility.**
 
• **An important feature of population growth in India is the development of its adolescents**.
 
 
• Currently, the share of adolescents i.e., up to the age group of 10-19 years is around **20.9 percent** (2011), among which male adolescents constitute **52.7 percent **and female adolescents constitute** 47.3 percent.**
 
 
 
• **Migration** is the movement of a person from one country, locality, place of residence, etc., to settle in another.

questions.question: _______________ is commonly known as imperfect fungi because only the asexual or vegetative phases of these fungi are known.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Deuteromycetes.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Deuteromycetes** commonly called **moulds** are **“second-class” fungi that have no known sexual state in their life cycle, and thus reproduce only by producing spores via mitosis**.
 
• **Deuteromycetes** are also known as **imperfect fungi. **
 
• They show only the asexual phase and **do not show sexual reproduction.**
 
• They reproduce asexually by forming** conidia**.
 
• Deuteromycetes are commonly known as** imperfect fungi because only their vegetative and asexual phases are known. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Phycomycetes** are **an obsolete polyphyletic taxon for certain fungi with aseptate hyphae**. 

 
 
• Asexual reproduction occurs by **zoospores(motile) or by Aplanospores(non-motile). **
 
• These spores are endogenously generated in the** sporangium.**** **
 
 
 
• **Basidiomycota** is **a important lineage of fungi embracing more than 40,000 species accounting for roughly 1/3 of fungal species**. 
 
 
• It comprises important groups such as **mushrooms, plant pathogenetic smut, rust, and industrially important yeast.**
 
 
 
• **Ascomycota** is a** phylum of the kingdom Fungi** that, combined with the Basidiomycota, forms the sub kingdom **Dikarya.**
 
• Its members are generally called as** sac fungi or ascomycetes.**

questions.question: _____________ is broadly divided into Western Ghats and Eastern Ghats.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Deccan plateau.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Deccan Plateau** is explained as the whole **southern peninsula of India south of the Narmada River.**
 
• Deccan plateau is generally divided into** Western Ghats and Eastern Ghats.**
 
• It is a high triangular tableland, surrounded on the** west and east by the Western Ghats and the Eastern Ghats,** sequentially, that meet at the **plateau's southern tip and to the north, across Satpura and Vindhya Ranges.**
 
• **Narmada river and Vindhyan range** splits the Deccan Plateau into two parts. 
 
• Upper part is famous as** central highlands **and lower part is famous as** Deccan plateau.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **​**The** Himalayas** is a mountain range in Asia, dividing the plains of the Indian subcontinent from the** Tibetan Plateau.**
 
• **The northern plain** has been founded by the interplay of the three important river systems,** namely the Indus, the Ganga and the Brahmaputra along with their tributaries.**
 
• **Central Highlands** is a tableland of bumpy surface, from **1500 to 2500 ft above the sea.**

questions.question: When Alivardi Khan died in 1756, ______ became the nawab of Bengal.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Siraj-ud-daulah.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Siraj ud-Daulah** was **one of the most famous nawab of Bengal**. ​ 
 
• **Siraj ud-Daulah** became the Nawab of Bengal later the death of **Alivardi Khan in 1756. **
 
• He was the **last self-ruling emperor** of Bengal.
 
• Siraj-ud-daulah had requested Britishers to **stop fortification** which became one of the causes for the war.
 
• The end of his reign shows the **end of the independent rule in India** and starting of the company's sovereignty that continued **unabated over the next two hundred years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mir Jafar ****first Bengal ruler (1757–60; 1763–65) under British control, which he helped bring about by working for the defeat of Mughal rule there**.
 
• **Murshid Quli Khan **was the **first Nawab of Bengal, ruling from 1717 to 1727**. 
 
• **Mir Qasim** was the **Nawab of Bengal, ruling from 1760 to 1763**.
